meta.name: release-versioning-convention
meta.description: Define semver policy, changelog/release notes flow, tagging rules, and breaking-change handling. Use when preparing or automating releases.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定义语义化版本策略与发布流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中规范版本号与发布流程。
copy.tagline_en: Define semantic versioning policy and release workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to standardize versioning and release process in your project.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你制定语义化版本策略、生成变更日志和发布说明、定义标签规则，并处理破坏性变更。每次发布变更都会包含版本号变更理由和更新日志条目。
howto.when: 当你准备或自动化发布流程时触发，例如在提交代码、创建标签或编写发布说明时。

say.text: 帮我为这次发布生成版本号和变更日志。
say.note: Claude 会读取仓库证据并输出版本策略和发布清单。

say.text: 这个提交有破坏性变更，更新版本策略。
say.note: Claude 会处理破坏性变更并更新标签规则。

howto.what_en: Claude will help you define semantic versioning policy, generate changelog and release notes, define tagging rules, and handle breaking changes. Every release change includes version bump rationale and notes entry.
howto.when_en: Triggered when preparing or automating releases, such as when committing code, creating tags, or writing release notes.

say_en.text: Generate version number and changelog for this release.
say_en.note: Claude will read repo evidence and output version policy and release checklist.

say_en.text: This commit has a breaking change, update version policy.
say_en.note: Claude will handle breaking changes and update tagging rules.
